      • addClient

        public boolean addClient​(CollectoClientHandler client,
                         java.lang.String userName)
        Adds the client handler to the List of connected clients, if the userName of the client is unique. Only call this method once the client has sent the HELLO protocol.
        Parameters:
        client - : the client handler assigned to the client.
        userName - : user name sent for inspection by the client.
        Returns:
        true if user name is unique and client has been added to connectedClients, else false
        Requires
        client != null, userName != null
        Ensures
        connectedClients.add(client);

      • removeClient

        public void removeClient​(CollectoClientHandler client)
        Removes the client from the List of connectedClients and queuedClients in case the client handler was in the queue as well.
        Parameters:
        client - : the client handler assigned to the client.
        Requires
        client != null, connectedClients.contains(client).
        Ensures
        connectedClients.remove(client), queuedClients.remove(client) if (queuedClients.contains(client)).

      • queue

        public void queue​(CollectoClientHandler client)
        Implements the QUEUE protocol. Add the passed CollectoClientHandler to the queuedClients List and checks whether there are enough people in the queue to start a newgame. If so, calls startNewGame().
        Parameters:
        client - : the client handler assigned to the client.
        Requires
        client != null.
        Ensures
        queuedClients.remove(client) if queuedClients.contains(client), queuedClients.add(client) if !queuedClients.contains(client).

      • getUsers

        public java.lang.String getUsers()
        Implements the LIST protocol. Returns a string containing all of the user names of the clients in connectedClients.

        a string containing all of the user names connected to this server.
